description:
Patch a coupon's editable fields.

Pass only the fields you want to change.  To set a cap to
unlimited (NULL in the schema), pass ``clear_uses_per_patron=true``
or ``clear_total_uses=true``.  Renaming the code is allowed —
existing patron redemption rows survive (they key on coupon id).
``tool_ids`` replaces the coupon's binding — tool ids or MCP tool
names, ``["*"]`` for every paid tool, ``[]`` to unbind it.

RESTRICTED to operator — requires proof.

clear_uses_per_patron.description: True makes discounted calls per patron unlimited.

coupon_id.description: The id of the coupon to change (from list_coupons).

discount_percent.description: A new percentage off the base price (0-100).

dpop_token.description:
Proof that the caller holds the operator's npub: the grant
envelope from receive_npub_proof, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235
Nostr event signed by the operator whose `u` tag is this tool's name.

name.description: A new code for patrons to type.

tool_ids.description:
The tools the coupon discounts: tool ids or MCP tool names,
["*"] for every paid tool, [] to unbind it.

total_uses.description: A new number of redemptions across all patrons.

uses_per_patron.description: A new number of discounted calls per patron.

valid_from.description: A new ISO-8601 datetime when the coupon becomes active.

valid_until.description: A new ISO-8601 datetime when the coupon expires.

name: beesknees_update_coupon
title: Update coupon
